message: Stripe billing backend is ready. 4 endpoints: POST /api/billing/create-checkout (body: {plan: starter|pro|agency, success_url?, cancel_url?} -> {checkout_url, session_id}), POST /api/billing/webhook (Stripe signature verified, no auth), GET /api/billing/subscription (-> {plan, stripe_plan, stripe_status, has_subscription}), POST /api/billing/portal (body: {return_url?} -> {portal_url}). Env vars needed: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER, STRIPE_PRICE_PRO, STRIPE_PRICE_AGENCY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Frontend flow: call create-checkout with plan name, redirect to checkout_url. For manage subscription, call portal and redirect to portal_url.
